payload.root_detail: bctcQueueEnricherJob has a logic bug: when discovery returns 0 URLs and item.attempts === 0, the code intentionally does NOT increment attempts (line 509: 'leave pending at 0'). Design intent was 'don't penalise new rows on first pass'. Effect: ALL rows that return 0 URLs on first attempt stay at attempts=0 FOREVER, never reach MAX_ENRICH_ATTEMPTS=5, never get marked url_not_found. They cycle infinitely causing the zero-url counter to increment every cron tick.

payload.fix_description: Remove the attempts===0 special-case that prevents increment. Replace with: always increment attempts when discovery returns 0 URLs (regardless of current attempts value). The 'truly new row' distinction is no longer needed — or can be done via last_attempt IS NULL check. This lets rows that genuinely have no discoverable URL accumulate attempts and eventually reach MAX_ENRICH_ATTEMPTS=5, getting marked url_not_found (honest terminal state). Zero-url counter resets once the 9 pending rows are marked url_not_found.
